_instrukcja: Angielska wersja kafle.json dla strony /en/. Struktura i pola techniczne (obraz, status, kadr, fokus, adresy) są takie same jak w kafle.json; tłumaczy się tylko teksty: nazwa, typ, zdanie, dopisek, alt, atrybucja, etykiety przycisków, alt i podpis w galerii.
Nowy kafel dopisuje się w obu plikach, w tej samej kolejności. Typ musi być jedną z angielskich nazw z listy kategorie (w tej samej kolejności co w kafle.json).

kafle.zdanie: A game designed by schoolgirls from the school in Klebark Wielki, moved from a paper version to an interactive map with a quiz and a bestiary.

galeria.alt: Start screen: a dark illustration of a swamp with a werewolf and wraiths, the caption “Whispers of the Swamp · Purda Municipality · Warmia”, the title “Olsztyn Glossary” and a “Begin the journey” button.

galeria.alt: Illustrated map of the municipality with a numbered route from start to finish, round thumbnails of places and the player’s character card with skill bars.

galeria.alt: Bestiary card: an illustration of the Południca (Noon Witch), a figure in a white veil holding a sickle in a field of grain under the full sun, next to a description of the spirit, her place in Slavic beliefs, her stats, weaknesses and resistances.

kafle.zdanie: A city game platform available throughout the season. Participants have accounts and an achievement system, and the organiser gets statistics.

In the foreground, a table with a candle in a lantern, scrolls and an open book.

galeria.alt: The same portal in historical style: a light sandy background, a character card with a brick frame and a grid of achievements.

kafle.alt: Toruń Green Map: a “Right now” bar with places where the season is under way, season and district filters, a city map with pins and a list of places.

galeria.alt: Map view: a “Right now” bar with four places where the season is under way, season and district filters, a map of Toruń with pins and sample routes.

galeria.alt: Atlas tab, “Wild bank of the Vistula” card: a photo of an overgrown riverbank with a sandbar, a short description of the place and two season bars (ice floes on the Vistula, green riverbank) with the number of days until they begin.
galeria.podpis: Atlas: the “Wild bank of the Vistula” card

galeria.alt: “Lilacs in Bydgoskie Przedmieście” card: a close-up of lilac in bloom, a description of a walk through the district’s side streets and a flowering season bar (25 April – 25 May).
galeria.podpis: Atlas: the “Lilacs in Bydgoskie Przedmieście” card

galeria.alt: Planner tab: a walk builder with pace, time and distance, and a preview of a conversation with the map in which a sentence turns into a route.

galeria.alt: Header of the report “Night-time alcohol sales in Krosno”, a result of 55.1% in favour of restrictions and five summary figures against a neon map of the city.
galeria.podpis: Overall consultation results

galeria.alt: “The same issue looks different in every part of the city” section: a table of districts with support bars and a panel with the full reading for one district.
galeria.podpis: Results by district

galeria.alt: “Age and gender strongly affect the answers” section: charts for and against restrictions by age group and the profile of the people who completed the survey.
galeria.podpis: Answers by age and gender

galeria.alt: “Hard numbers don’t answer every question” section: data on night-time public order disturbances, drinking in prohibited places and interventions.

kafle.nazwa: ISKRA: Atlas of Voices, Sienkiewicza Street
kafle.zdanie: Residents’ opinions gathered during 26 research walks, compiled as input for planning a creative district. The fieldwork was carried out by psychology students.
kafle.alt: Two photos of an old tram depot side by side: on the left its current state (brick halls with gates and tracks), on the right an AI visualisation of the same place as an evening square with string lights and people at tables.

galeria.alt: “Old tram depot” block from the Visualising the potential section: a photo of the current state (brick halls with gates and tracks) and an AI visualisation of the same place as an evening meeting square with string lights.
galeria.podpis: Old tram depot: current state and AI visualisation

galeria.alt: “Participant profile” section: five figures, including mean and median age, and charts of gender, roles and length of connection with Bydgoskie Przedmieście.
galeria.podpis: Profile of study participants

galeria.alt: “Places named by respondents” chart: from Bydgoski Park, named in 24 of 26 reports, downwards, coloured by rating.
galeria.podpis: Most frequently named places

kafle.zdanie: Tourism analysis for a management board: the structure and seasonality of arrivals, month by month and year by year.
kafle.alt: Map of Europe with lines of foreign visitor arrivals converging on Szczecin; line thickness reflects the number of visitors, and the figures themselves are blurred.

galeria.alt: “Where foreign visitors sail in from” view: a map of Europe with arrival lines to Szczecin, group (tourists, day visitors) and period switches, and a ranking of countries by share of all visitors, led by Germany, Ukraine and the United Kingdom. Visitor numbers blurred.
galeria.podpis: Countries of origin of foreign visitors

galeria.alt: “August compared with July” chart: the ratio of August to July visitor numbers in 2023–2026 for six groups, from domestic tourists to day visitors from Germany, with a note on the limitations of the comparison.
galeria.podpis: August against July in four consecutive years

galeria.alt: Month roses for visitors from individual countries: for each country, the year’s visitors broken down by month, with the peak month highlighted, e.g. August for Germany and September for Ukraine. Total visitor numbers blurred.
galeria.podpis: Arrivals over the year by country

kafle.zdanie: An analysis of how exposed the city’s neighbourhoods are to ETS2, the EU carbon price on heating and transport fuels, and a district heating scenario up to 2040, based on public data.
kafle.alt: “Neighbourhoods and ETS2 exposure” view: a map of Bydgoszcz neighbourhoods in five classes of solid-fuel heating devices per 1,000 residents, next to a panel with city-wide data and a legend.

galeria.alt: “Neighbourhoods and ETS2 exposure” view: a data status bar, a map of Bydgoszcz neighbourhoods on an OpenStreetMap base in five classes of solid-fuel devices per 1,000 residents, and a city panel: 176.0 km², 18,395 devices, 61.2 per 1,000 residents and the estimated ETS2 cost for a coal-heated house.
galeria.podpis: Neighbourhood map: solid-fuel devices and ETS2 exposure

galeria.alt: 2040 scenario: assumption sliders (building retrofits, heat pumps, low-emission sources, heat recovery, ETS2 allowance price) and the result for 2040: heat demand, emission reduction, investment, annual system cost, and charts of the emissions pathway and the heat supply mix.
galeria.podpis: 2040 scenario: assumptions and result

galeria.alt: Top of the “Heat scenario to 2040” view: the annual cost of heating a coal-heated detached house today and from 2028, and an assessment of whether the district heating system meets the efficient-system criterion.
galeria.podpis: Household heating cost and district heating system assessment
